_doc: Signal engine v2 tunables — the single source for every number the engine uses. Loaded by signal_engine/settings.py. Env SIGNAL_ENRICHMENT_MODEL overrides llm.model at runtime (ops); everything else changes here.

urgency._doc: structural_by_role: floor per taxonomy signal role (keys must be signal_roles in taxonomy_base.json). perceived_bands: LLM urgency_score → level. Effective = max(structural, perceived), escalation_probability ≥ boost_threshold lifts perceived one level. Floors cover risk AND opportunity: expansion_intent is high because a stalled expansion is lost revenue, not just a missed nicety.
